result.description:
Can I speak to the manager?

Because we have a great offer for you!

The San Telmo Group is looking for a Front of House Manager to take charge at one of our thriving city venues.

Who are we?

The San Telmo Group made its mark on the Melbourne restaurant scene over 10 years ago with our flagship venue, San Telmo. Delivering traditional Argentine cuisine and premium meat cooked over charcoal and fire on custom built parrilla grills. We have since expanded to 5 bustling city venues championing contemporary Argentine, Peruvian and Japanese cuisine. Our mission is to provide excellent produce, informed and friendly service in a relaxed and casual environment with fun and professional staff.

Why should you work for us?

We understand that it takes more than a pay-check at the end of the week to remain challenged, motivated and happy in your job. We have great job retention at The San Telmo Group because we invest in professional development, offer flexibility in our rosters with potential 4 day working weeks, and we give all our staff the opportunity to contribute their ideas to the business in a supportive environment. Here are some of the benefits we offer.

Quarterly and annual bonuses based on performance up to $29k PA
Up to 5K per year in external training. This will set you up to progress or run your own business one day
40% discount at all San Telmo Group Restaurants
In house training, clear job descriptions and development plans
38 hour working week.
A workplace that prioritises training and team building
Walk into a well structured restaurant with trained staff so you can focus on improving the business rather than fixing a broken operation
Mentoring from directors and professional hospitality consultants to help you achieve your goals
What does this role involve?

The role of Front of House Manager focuses on the ongoing and future success of the business. Including: The usual day-to-day running of the business, contributing to the growth in revenue, managing all front-of-house profit and loss, forward planning and innovation, recruitment, training and mentoring staff.

Who is our ideal candidate?

We are looking for a front of house manager who leads by example with a positive attitude. They would have proven experience with successful control of wage, cost of goods, staff turnover targets and building revenue. They possess strong leadership qualities and gain respect through hard work and example. They have great product and industry knowledge and are both firm and empathetic to their team.

If you dream of owning your own venue one day or are looking for solid career development with numerous financial incentives, The San Telmo Group is the company for you.

Apply today! All cover letters with a short statement of why you think this role is for you will be favourable.

Summary of role requirements:
Looking for candidates available to work evenings and weekends
More than 4 years of relevant work experience required for this role

result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Restaurant Manager for our client in St Kilda, Victoria. This role requires the ability to work well under pressure, with excellent organisational and time management skills to ensure smooth service across all aspects of restaurant operations.

Job Description

•	Oversee the daily operations of the restaurant.

•	Manage financial performance and take appropriate actions to improve profitability.

•	Monitor food and beverage quality served to ensure consistent high-quality standards.

•	Collaborate with the owners and kitchen staff to develop menu items aligning with the preferences of the target demographic, seasonal availability of ingredients, and budgetary constraints.

•	Liaise effectively with suppliers to order inventory, ensuring purchased items remain in line with budgets.

•	Liaise with customers upon completion of meals to ensure satisfaction.

•	Address any customer concerns or complaints by informing staff of certain areas that require improvement.

•	Oversee, select, and train staff to address any gaps in knowledge as required.

•	Create rosters, ensuring an appropriate number of staff are on hand.

•	Ensuring restaurant cleanliness and compliance with Occupational Health and Safety Standards.

Qualifications / Attributes

•	Must hold a Diploma of Hospitality Management or a relevant Diploma, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

•	Must possess at least three (3) years of relevant work experience as a Restaurant Manager or in a similar hospitality management role.

•	Excellent organisational and time management skills to ensure smooth service.

•	Ability to work well under pressure in a busy restaurant environment.

•	Strong financial management skills including budgeting and profitability improvement.

•	Excellent communication and customer service skills.

•	Ability to lead, train, and manage a diverse hospitality team.

Salary

$75,000 – $85,000 per annum excluding superannuation.

Join the Sweet Team at Honey Cube Pty Ltd!
Position: Retail Manager (Full-Time)
Location: Minto, NSW
Salary: $78,000 – $85,000 + Superannuation

Honey Cube Pty Ltd is buzzing with excitement! As one of Australia and New Zealand’s most trusted names in premium honey — from cold raw honey and organic blends to indulgent honeycomb and world-renowned Manuka — we’re all about delivering natural goodness to our customers.
With rapid growth in both our Minto store and our thriving online shop, we’re on the lookout for a passionate, energetic Retail Manager to lead our hive!

What You’ll Be Doing
• Overseeing the day-to-day magic of our busy retail store
• Crafting clever purchasing, pricing, and marketing strategies
• Showcasing and promoting our delicious honey products
• Sharing your sweet knowledge with customers — from flavour notes to dietary benefits
• Managing stock, keeping accurate records, and ensuring financial transactions run smoothly
• Assisting with budgets and cost control under the Director’s guidance
• Recruiting, mentoring, and inspiring sales staff to deliver exceptional service
• Keeping our in-store and online retail operations running smoothly
• Handling customer feedback, exchanges, and refunds with care
• Ensuring our store meets all safety and compliance requirements

What You’ll Bring to the Hive
• A qualification in Management and IT
• Minimum 2 years’ experience in retail management
• Bonus points for expertise in retail software and honey product knowledge
• Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills
• Excellent spoken and written English
• Availability to work on-site at our Minto store
• A positive, proactive attitude and a genuine passion for customer service and team leadership

Why You’ll Love Working With Us
If you’re a people-person with a love for natural products — especially Australian honey and by-products — this is your chance to shine in a fun, friendly, and fast-growing environment!
How to Apply
Send your resume to info@businessnest.com.au with “Retail Manager” in the subject line.
Don’t wait — let your next career step bee the sweetest one yet!
Applications open on 15 July 2026 and close on 14 August 2026
